coordinate_frame: F1 position frame, converted from 1/10 m; NOT Track world frame
selection: IsAccurate; not deleted; no pit in/out; green TrackStatus 1; fastest accepted first; excludes already exported session laps 8 and 17
interpolation: FastF1 get_telemetry(original) merges native car/position timestamps and interpolates channels and lap edges. No extra fixed-rate resampling or filling here. Source counts are row origins, not per-channel proof of measurement.
distance_plot: Trapezoidal integral of speed over time, relative to first exported sample; estimated travelled distance, not track centreline s.

quality_review.reason: Three distinct additional qualifying laps requested; reviewed native streams have no missing channel values, cover the lap, and have longest gaps no larger than 1.26 seconds.
quality_review.limitation: These exploratory records pass a looser gap policy than the original two laps. FastF1 interpolates channels across native gaps. Passing these checks does not certify precise positions or control timing during gaps.
